title: Accountant
company: Heera Panna Innerwear and Casual wear
description:
**Company Description**
Heera Panna Innerwear and Casual Wear is a growing apparel business focused on providing comfortable, stylish innerwear and casual clothing to a diverse customer base. The company operates in the Kolkata metropolitan area and Tirupur, Tamil Nadu and is involved in both retail and wholesale activities. Team members collaborate closely across sales, inventory, and finance to support efficient operations and customer satisfaction. Heera Panna values reliability, integrity, and attention to detail, especially within its accounting and financial functions. The organization offers opportunities to contribute to a dynamic, fast-paced environment in the fashion and apparel sector.

**Role Description**
This is a full-time, on-site Accountant role based in the Kolkata metropolitan area. The Accountant will manage day-to-day bookkeeping, including recording transactions, maintaining ledgers, and reconciling bank statements. Responsibilities include preparing invoices, monitoring accounts payable and receivable, handling GST and other statutory compliances, and assisting with payroll calculations. The role involves preparing periodic financial reports, supporting budgeting, and coordinating with management to provide accurate financial insights. The Accountant will also work with internal and external stakeholders such as vendors, auditors, and tax consultants to ensure compliance and timely financial operations.

**Qualifications**

* Candidates should possess strong knowledge of accounting principles, bookkeeping, and financial reporting.
* Candidates should possess proficiency in accounting software (e.g., Tally, ERP systems) and MS Excel for data analysis and record-keeping.
* Candidates should possess skills in tax and statutory compliance, including GST, TDS, and basic payroll processing.
* Candidates should possess attention to detail, numerical accuracy, and the ability to manage multiple financial tasks simultaneously.
* Candidates should possess effective communication and collaboration skills to work with management, vendors, and auditors.
* Candidates should ideally have a bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Commerce, or a related field.
* Prior experience in retail, apparel, or manufacturing finance will be considered an advantage.
* Candidates should possess the ability to work on-site in the Kolkata metropolitan area and maintain high standards of integrity and confidentiality.
